large_tfidf_boosting_fit.rule: Require a per-job justified additional memory estimate plus 1GiB available reserve; no universal4GiB floor and no assumption a heavy model fits within the small-job budgets.

guards: Fresh memory check while holding shared OS lock before allocations/reservations/target access/fit.
Available >= workload initial floor AND available - justified additional estimate >= projected reserve.
Serial origins/batches; release large arrays after each origin.
Check actual available memory at load/stage boundaries; stop resumably if below workload reserve.
Keep OS lock/temp path, one heavy job, two threads; no killing other apps or polling while idle.
Capture process RSS and OS peak working set when supported; mark sampled metrics accurately.
Never retry consumed fits or change model/scientific gates to work around a resource stop.
scope: Apply through versioned technical source/freezes to currently unstarted stages.
Preserve earlier resource policies/freezes/failed preflight receipts as history.
No changes to model recipe, performance gates, threshold, donor mapping, data/label boundaries or fit allowance.
This policy is not itself permission for an unapproved fit, evaluation or submission.
